opportunities.title: APEX Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Established independent researchers based in a UK university or not‑for‑profit research organisation, holding a permanent or fixed‑term position with teaching/administrative duties.
opportunities.summary: Funding up to £200,000 for interdisciplinary, curiosity‑driven research by established researchers, supporting staff, research and public engagement costs.

opportunities.title: SHAPE Involve and Engage
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based researchers at any career stage with prior public engagement experience (or willing to develop it), not previously awarded.
opportunities.summary: Funding up to £8,000 for innovative public engagement projects with GLAM or performing arts organisations.

opportunities.title: The Alexander von Humboldt Foundation and The British Academy Knowledge Frontiers Symposium 2027
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career researchers in humanities or social sciences affiliated with UK or German research institutions.
opportunities.summary: Funding for early‑career scholars to attend a 2027 symposium on Humans and Nature, covering travel, accommodation, visa and seed funding for collaborations.

opportunities.title: Postdoctoral Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career researchers in humanities/social sciences, UK‑based, doctorate completed between 1 Apr 2024‑1 Apr 2027, not holding a permanent academic post.
opportunities.summary: Three‑year fellowships covering 80% of salary costs for independent research leading to a publishable output.

opportunities.title: Talent Development Awards 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑resident researchers with a long‑term appointment at a UK HEI or IRO in humanities or social sciences.
opportunities.summary: Awards up to £10,000 for UK researchers to develop quantitative, data‑science, digital humanities or language skills and disseminate them.

opportunities.title: International Interdisciplinary Research Projects 2027
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based principal investigator in humanities/social sciences, postdoctoral or above, with long‑term appointment; must involve overseas co‑applicants and interdisciplinary collaboration.
opportunities.summary: Up to £300k for two‑year interdisciplinary projects on mobilities, led by UK researchers with international partners.

opportunities.title: Global Innovation Fellowships: The German Council on Foreign Relations (DGAP) 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based early‑ or mid‑career researchers in humanities/social sciences.
opportunities.summary: One‑year fellowships hosted at DGAP in Berlin, up to £150k, to develop policy‑relevant analysis in areas such as security, Indo‑European relations, AI, and strategy‑making.

opportunities.title: Additional Needs
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Current British Academy award‑holders or applicants planning to apply for a British Academy award within six months.
opportunities.summary: Funding up to £4,000 for additional needs such as equipment, caring costs, or support to make applications.
